integrity: Self-contained analytic proof, exact algebraic identities and standalone numerical cross-checks; no claim of external or independent mathematical audit.
scientific_limitations: Sharp criterion classifies radius saturation and every center, not the inradius or centers of matrices failing the criterion; the coordinate Euclidean metric is essential; historical priority remains provisional. Finite numerical LP tests are not an infinite certificate.
title: A sharp simplex-projection inball criterion for Cayley sums of boxes
